shortBio.en: Smashing Pumpkins drummer; jazz-trained kit under alt-rock walls of guitar.
shortBio.zh: Smashing Pumpkins 鼓手；alt-rock 吉他墙下的爵士训练鼓组。

body.en:
Born 1964. Gish through Mellon Collie pocket. Exits/returns across eras; peak chemistry with Corgan/Wretzky/Iha.

Drums keep prog ambition inside radio singles.
body.zh:
1964 年生。Gish 至 Mellon Collie 律动。跨时期离合；与 Corgan/Wretzky/Iha 峰值化学反应。

鼓把 prog 野心留在电台单曲里。
